Draft: households' network charges +2.8% on average, largest customers -6%; gas distribution +3.6% (Prague ~+5%); D02d distribution +122.08 to 2,637.16 CZK/MWh incl. VAT (Seznam Zprávy 2 Nov). Checkable: final average change vs the +2.8% draft. Not expected on Thu 26 Nov. Correction 25 Nov: ERÚ issues on the last working day of November (2023: 30 Nov; 2024: 29 Nov; 2025: 28 Nov), so this year most likely Mon 30 Nov.

Those are not January list changes.
